Where to begin

The two books Fr. John reads with catechumens

Anyone preparing to be received into the Church here works through these two alongside Fr. John, which is why the bookstore keeps both in stock. You do not have to be a catechumen to pick one up. They are the same two books we put in the hands of anyone who says they would like to read something.

Catechism

Know the Faith

A Handbook for Orthodox Christians and Inquirers
Fr. Michael Shanbour · Ancient Faith Publishing

Goes through the faith one subject at a time — the Trinity, the Church, the sacraments, the saints — and assumes the reader is starting from nothing. The chapters are short on purpose. It is written to be read a piece at a time and then talked over.

Reserve
Catechism

The Orthodox Church

An Introduction to Eastern Christianity
Timothy Ware, later Metropolitan Kallistos Ware · Penguin

The standard introduction, in print since 1963. The history first, then what the Church believes and how it worships. Ware came to Orthodoxy from outside it as a young man and later became a bishop, and the book is written for someone standing where he once stood.
